# Hannune Console

> The Hannune Console is where you sign up for Hannune's APIs, manage your API keys, and choose a plan. Hannune is a one-person company in Seoul, South Korea, building cross-lingual entity resolution and Graph RAG tooling. The console itself is not the API; it is the account and billing front end for api.hannune.ai.

## Services

- [Entity Resolution API](https://app.hannune.ai/entity-resolution): Resolves different spellings and languages of the same entity ("Samsung Elec", "삼성전자") to one canonical record. Handles abbreviations, typos and Korean-English cross-lingual matching. API base: https://api.hannune.ai/entity-resolution/v1

## Plans (Entity Resolution API)

- Free: 0 USD/month, 1,000 matches, 10 requests/min, core resolution.
- Starter: 19 USD/month, 10,000 matches, 60 requests/min, CSV upload.
- Pro: 99 USD/month, 100,000 matches, 300 requests/min, LLM disambiguation, Graph RAG presets.
- Business: 499 USD/month, 1,000,000 matches, 1,000 requests/min, all Pro features, priority support.
- Enterprise: custom pricing, custom rate limits, SSO, SLA, on-premise option.

Matching quality is the same on every plan. Plans differ in request limits, CSV upload, LLM disambiguation and Graph RAG presets.

## Account

- Sign up: https://app.hannune.ai/signup (email + password)
- Log in: https://app.hannune.ai/login
- Payments are handled by Polar as Merchant of Record.
